title: Your Excuses Are Expensive | A Discipline Short Film
lines: I'm tired. I'm busy. I'll start Monday.
Every excuse sounds reasonable. That's why it works so well.
But look at what each one costs you.
A year of Mondays is still a year.
He deletes the excuses one by one, and replaces them with a plan.
You don't need better reasons. You need fewer excuses.
Start before you're ready. Ready never comes.
